products.overview: Nitrogen and protein results depend on how consistently every distillation starts and ends. The BUCHI Kjel Line recognizes the distillation endpoint automatically, and on BasicKjel and MultiKjel, AutoDist recognizes the start of distillation too. MaxAccuracy Mode compensates power grid fluctuations with an integrated voltage stabilizer, and recovery is above 99.5 % by direct distillation. Choose EasyKjel, BasicKjel or MultiKjel. Steam power adjusts from 10 to 100 % with programmable steam ramps, the optional reaction detection sensor (MultiKjel) saves up to 30 % of NaOH, and cooling water control saves approximately 20 % of water.

faqs.question: What is the Kjel Line used for?
faqs.answer: The Kjel Line is a steam distillation unit for nitrogen determination: Total Kjeldahl Nitrogen, Total Volatile Basic Nitrogen, nitrate and nitrite. Applications cover food and beverage, feed, chemicals and fertilizers, environmental analysis, and pharmaceuticals and biotechnology.

faqs.question: What is the difference between EasyKjel, BasicKjel and MultiKjel?
faqs.answer: EasyKjel has a color display and NaOH pump; BasicKjel adds an H2O pump and AutoDist; MultiKjel adds a touch screen, sample disposal and a boric acid pump as standard. Only MultiKjel offers receiver disposal, titrator connection and the reaction detection sensor, all as options.

faqs.question: What is the measuring range of the Kjel Line?
faqs.answer: The measuring range is 0.02 to 220 mg N on all three configurations.

faqs.question: How accurate is the Kjel Line?
faqs.answer: Recovery is above 99.5 % for direct distillation and above 98 % with the digestion process, from 1 to 220 mg N. Measurement reproducibility is below 0.8 % for 1 mg N with 300 s distillation.

faqs.question: What does AutoDist do?
faqs.answer: AutoDist recognizes the start of the condensation process and adjusts the distillation start time automatically in each measurement, using a built-in temperature sensor in the condensate vessel.

faqs.question: What is MaxAccuracy Mode?
faqs.answer: MaxAccuracy Mode uses an integrated voltage stabilizer to maintain the required supply voltage, as laboratory supply voltage can deviate by up to 10 %.

faqs.question: How do I reduce NaOH consumption in Kjeldahl distillation?
faqs.answer: Add the reaction detection sensor to a MultiKjel configuration to save up to 30 % of NaOH reagent solution in the alkalization process.

faqs.question: How do I automate titration with the Kjel Line?
faqs.answer: Choose MultiKjel with the optional titrator connection and connect a supported titrator, such as the Metrohm Eco Titrator. Titration dosage and endpoint recognition via suitable electrodes then run automatically.

faqs.question: What is the price of the Kjel Line in India?
faqs.answer: Pricing depends on the configuration and options. Contact Inkarp for a quotation on +91 8125580808 or info@inkarp.co.in.

faqs.question: Who is the authorized distributor for the Kjel Line in India?
faqs.answer: Inkarp is the authorized distributor and service provider for the Kjel Line in India, with support for installation, training, AMC and application support.

intro: The overview of the Kjel Line covers its role in nitrogen determination by steam distillation.
The BUCHI Kjel Line is a steam distillation unit for nitrogen determination: Total Kjeldahl Nitrogen, Total Volatile Basic Nitrogen, nitrate and nitrite.

EasyKjel has a color display and NaOH pump. BasicKjel adds an H2O pump and AutoDist. MultiKjel adds a touch screen, sample disposal and a boric acid pump, with receiver disposal, titrator connection and a reaction detection sensor as options.

sections.title: The Kjeldahl distillation workflow
sections.description: How the Kjel Line works, from sample tube to result: sample tube, reagent dosing, steam distillation, distillation endpoint, titration and disposal.

steps.title: Sample Tube
steps.description: The sample tube is put in place. A safety sensor checks that it is positioned correctly, and the process stops automatically if the safety shields are opened during operation.

steps.title: Reagent Dosing
steps.description: Reagents are dosed by the NaOH pump (all configurations), the H2O pump (BasicKjel, MultiKjel) and the boric acid pump (MultiKjel). The optional reaction detection sensor (MultiKjel) saves up to 30 % of NaOH reagent solution.

steps.title: Steam Distillation
steps.description: Steam power runs at 10 to 100 %, with programmable steam ramps for foaming samples and no preheating required. AutoDist (BasicKjel, MultiKjel) recognizes the start of distillation automatically.

steps.title: Distillation Endpoint
steps.description: The distillation endpoint is recognized automatically. With the optional OnLevel sensor, the distillation stops after a defined condensate volume is reached.

steps.title: Titration
steps.description: With a connected titrator (MultiKjel, optional), titration dosage and endpoint recognition via suitable electrodes are carried out automatically.

steps.title: Disposal
steps.description: Sample tube waste is aspirated with sample disposal (BasicKjel optional, MultiKjel), and receiver waste with receiver disposal (MultiKjel optional).

sections.disclaimer: This workflow explanation is illustrative. Actual steps and settings depend on your sample, method and configuration.
